Use case: scientific-educational. Create an ORIGINAL complex domain-specific research figure, landscape 3:2, white background, crisp vector-like publication illustration, large highly legible English labels, precise directed arrows. Scientific fidelity is more important than decoration. Restrained indigo, teal and warm amber plus dark charcoal labels. Use clean sans-serif labels and correct mathematical notation. No watermark, no title outside the specified panel headings, no invented results or measured charts. Avoid microscopic detail; keep margins clear and arrows out of text. Each requested panel is a coherent academic layout, not a grid of generic UI cards. All details below are explicit scientific requirements.
Communications engineering, digital OFDM transceiver with pilots and equalization. Technical block schematic, flat rectangular computational blocks with ports and a clear two-row signal route. Upper row titled "Transmitter": left-to-right "Input bits" -> "QAM mapper" -> "Pilot insertion" -> "IFFT" -> "Add CP" -> "Multipath channel" at upper right. Small "Known pilots" sheet above Pilot insertion with arrow into it. Lower row titled "Receiver": from channel descend to "Remove CP" at lower right, then flow RIGHT-TO-LEFT into "FFT", "Equalizer", "QAM demapper", and "Output bits" at lower left. Every receiver arrow MUST point left, never reverse the scientific signal direction. From FFT also send a branch to small "Channel estimation" below the row, with another input from a separate "Known pilots" reference; channel estimate goes into Equalizer as a second input, not into QAM demapper. No direct Add CP -> FFT bypass. A small separate inset titled "Cyclic prefix" shows a flat sample strip whose tail is copied to the prefix; annotate just "CP" and "Symbol", and connect to Add CP by an undirected thin leader, not a process arrow. Optional channel icon has several echo paths with no numeric measurements. Overall roughly 14 main/aux blocks, restrained flat fills, uniform outlines, generous aligned routing and large words. Do not add RF hardware, performance numbers or channel equations.

Deep learning: original post-normalization Transformer ENCODER with self-attention detail. Scientific tensor architecture, shallow isometric token/matrix slabs and a precise enlarged attention detail, never a generic training loop. Three areas: left input embeddings, center vertical encoder block, right attention-detail panel. Left bottom "Input tokens" -> "Token embedding" (stack of gridded feature planes); a small separate "Positional encoding" slab also feeds a circled plus. Combined representation feeds the bottom of the center block. The center dashed boundary annotated "N×" encloses EXACTLY four computational stages going BOTTOM-TO-TOP: "Multi-head self-attention" -> "Add & Norm" -> "Feed-forward" -> "Add & Norm", then outside the top "Output embeddings" as a tensor stack. Residual 1 bypasses self-attention from its INPUT into the first Add & Norm; residual 2 bypasses Feed-forward from its INPUT into the second Add & Norm. Both residual arrowheads must end at their respective Add & Norm. Do not use Pre-LN, decoder cross-attention, autoregressive mask or task head. On right a separate magnified "Attention detail" connected from self-attention by a thin undirected detail leader, NOT a data-flow cycle. In that inset an input representation splits into three projections "Q", "K", "V". Q and K feed "QKᵀ / √dₖ" -> "Softmax"; Softmax and V feed "Weighted sum"; outputs of repeated heads go to "Concat" -> "Output projection". The detail panel represents multi-head self-attention; show small repeated head slabs symbolically with NO invented fixed tensor dimensions, heads or layer counts. Horizontal words and formulas, no perspective text. Large readable font, precise arrow direction, ample whitespace, restrained violet/teal tensor objects. Ensure two residual routes and both Add & Norm stages are visible.

RIGHT DETAIL: the single displayed attention calculation is an illustrative head; rename the rightmost output slab currently Head h to 'Head i', keep Head 1 and Head 2 and the ellipsis as representative other heads, and add a short readable annotation 'Repeated across h heads' near the head group if it fits. Make the output head group feed Concat with an unmistakable upward directed connector instead of only an ambiguous bracket. Do not alter the Q/K/V branches, QK^T/sqrt(d_k), Softmax -> Weighted sum, Concat -> Output projection, N× block, either Add & Norm or residual direction. No new task heads or fixed numerical dimensions.
